lines.zh: 软软的身体在地上滚动。
lines.en: Squishy body rolls on the ground.

lines.zh: 孢子在我身后拖成一条白线。
lines.en: Spores trail behind me in a white line.

lines.zh: 我一蹦一蹦，菌盖跟着晃。
lines.en: I hop and my cap wobbles along.
This head of mine bounces high.

lines.zh: 我的脑袋弹性很好，试试吗。
lines.en: My head is very springy; want to try it?

lines.zh: 菌盖下面，我在等谁走过来。
lines.en: Under my cap, I wait for someone to walk by.

lines.zh: 我在菌丝间打盹，软软的。
lines.en: I doze among the mycelium, soft and slack.
A little dew gathers under my cap.

lines.zh: 我把脑袋顶进泥土里歇一歇。
lines.en: I push my head into the soil to rest.
Spores drift slowly; so do I.

lines.zh: 我听见真菌平原在呼吸。
lines.en: I hear the fungal plains breathing.

lines.zh: 一点点光落在菌盖上，暖。
lines.en: A little light falls warm on my cap.
I wait for the others to hop over.
My head goes soft and I stop bothering to move.

lines.zh: 我歪着菌盖，看你的靴子。
lines.en: I tilt my cap and study your boots.

lines.zh: 我这颗脑袋，一顶你就退。
lines.en: One bump of this head and you back off.

lines.zh: 我拿弹性的脑袋碰碰你。
lines.en: I bump you with my springy head.
Suddenly turns to look at player.

lines.zh: 你的靴子，踩到我的菌丝了。
lines.en: Your boots are on my mycelium.

lines.zh: 我抬头，菌盖刚好到你膝盖。
lines.en: I look up; my cap just reaches your knee.
I need some more mushroom protein.

lines.zh: 菌盖被打歪，孢子撒了一地。
lines.en: My cap is knocked askew; spores spill everywhere.

lines.zh: 贪吃的小脑袋，蘑菇蛋白等你来拿！
lines.en: Tempted by its head? Mushroge in store!

lines.zh: 看这弹力脑袋，蘑菇蛋白就在不远处！
lines.en: Check out its bouncy head—mushroge ahead!

lines.zh: 想要蘑菇蛋白？靠近它，它不会咬人的！
lines.en: Craving some mushroge? Get close, it’s harmless!

lines.zh: 蘑菇蛋白，来自Mushlin Bumper的奖励！
别被它欺骗，蘑菇蛋白才是它的秘密！
lines.en: Don’t be fooled, it’s all about the mushroge!

lines.zh: 小心，靠近它只能得到蘑菇蛋白！
lines.en: Beware, getting close only yields mushroge!

lines.zh: 蘑菇蛋白，Mushlin Bumper的终极奖励！
蘑菇蛋白，别让Mushlin Bumper骗了你！
lines.en: Mushroge, don’t be tricked by Mushlin Bumper!

lines.zh: 靠近它，你就能得到蘑菇蛋白！
lines.en: Get close and you’ll get some mushroge!

lines.zh: 蘑菇蛋白，来自Mushlin Bumper的礼物！
lines.en: Mushroge, a gift from Mushlin Bumper!

lines.zh: 小心被顶飞，Mushlin Bumper的脑袋很弹！
lines.en: Watch out, Mushlin Bumper’s head is bouncy!

lines.zh: Mushlin Bumper用脑袋把玩家顶回去！
lines.en: Mushlin Bumper uses its head to bump players!
Don’t be bounced by Mushlin Bumper’s head!

lines.zh: 小心Mushlin Bumper的脑袋，它很弹力！
Mushlin Bumper的脑袋能把玩家顶飞！
lines.en: Mushlin Bumper’s head can bump you off your feet!
Mushlin Bumper’s head is super bouncy!

lines.zh: 被Mushlin Bumper的脑袋顶过一次就够了！
lines.en: One bump from Mushlin Bumper’s head is enough!

lines.zh: Mushlin Bumper用脑袋把玩家顶开！
lines.en: Mushlin Bumper uses its head to push players away!

lines.zh: 小心被Mushlin Bumper的脑袋弹开！
lines.en: Watch out for Mushlin Bumper’s bouncy head!
Mushlin Bumper uses its head to mate!
Watch Mushlin Bumper use its head to mate!

lines.zh: Mushlin Bumper用脑袋吸引另一半！
lines.en: Mushlin Bumper uses its head to attract a mate!
Mushlin Bumper uses its heads to bump each other!

lines.zh: Mushlin Bumper用脑袋互相顶来顶去！
lines.en: Mushlin Bumper uses its heads to bump around!

lines.zh: Mushlin Bumper用脑袋找伴儿成功！
lines.en: Mushlin Bumper uses its head to find a mate!

lines.zh: 看Mushlin Bumper用脑袋相互顶撞！
lines.en: Watch Mushlin Bumper use its heads to bump each other!
Mushlin Bumper uses its head to attract a companion!

lines.zh: Mushlin Bumper用脑袋互相顶撞寻找伴侣！
lines.en: Mushlin Bumper uses its heads to bump and find a mate!

lines.zh: Mushlin Bumper用脑袋互相顶来寻找伴侣！
lines.en: Mushlin Bumper uses its heads to bump and find a mate!

lines.zh: 你一靠近，我的菌盖就绷紧了。
lines.en: As you near, my cap pulls taut.
I crouch lower to bounce farther.

lines.zh: 软绵绵的脑袋顶你一下！
用脑袋撞你个头破血流！
用我的脑袋把你扔出去！
lines.en: Throw you out with my head!
Pop out of fungi to bump you!

lines.zh: 菌柄一撑，我从土里冒出来。
lines.en: My stalk pushes up and I pop out of soil.

lines.zh: 真菌平原上，冒出一颗脑袋。
lines.en: On the fungal plains, a head pops up.
My mushroom cap is on fire — hot!
Soaked in water, I go limp as a lump.

lines.zh: 炸开时，我的菌盖飞了半边。
lines.en: In the blast, half my cap flies off.

lines.zh: 魔法钻进菌褶，我抖出一片孢子。
lines.en: Magic seeps into my gills; I shake out spores.

lines.zh: 土里的养分不够，我瘪了。
lines.en: The soil's nutrients ran short; I sag.

lines.zh: 雷打在菌盖上，孢子都焦了。
lines.en: Lightning hits my cap; my spores are scorched.
Falling into the void, my threads still drift.
